item.title: National Ugly Christmas Sweater Day: A geek’s guide to festive knitwear
item.description: National Ugly Christmas Sweater Day is December 19th. We’ve curated a list of geeky knits, from Die Hard tributes to playable drinking games, to help you survive the festive season in style.

item.title: Complete your Shadowrun 5e collection with three massive end-of-year bundles
item.description: Bundle of Holding has launched three simultaneous offers for Shadowrun 5e, collecting the core rules, setting guides, and campaigns in a massive end-of-year event.

item.title: Dragonmeet award winners Three Sails announce February Kickstarter for Gallows Corner
item.description: Fresh from winning Best RPG at Dragonmeet, Three Sails Studios confirms the February 3rd Kickstarter launch for Gallows Corner.

item.title: A Spaceship Name Generator inspired by The Culture and John Scalzi
item.description: Need a starship name with a personality? Our generator creates names inspired by Iain M. Banks and John Scalzi, moving beyond standard military tropes.

item.title: Solving the RPG scheduling problem: Holger from Groupfinder discusses LFG safety
item.description: We interview Holger, founder of Groupfinder, about spotting red flags in LFG posts, solving scheduling conflicts, and the app's Estonian origins.

item.title: Hexcrawl review: Fly Me to the Moon
item.description: We explore the surreal lunar landscape of Fly Me to the Moon. Kabuki Kaiser delivers a high-concept OSR setting filled with crystal cities, Moonspells, and the unique Mathematician class

item.title: Entromancy publisher Nightpath announces shift from tabletop games to music
item.description: Nightpath Publishing is rebranding to Nightpath Studios and shifting focus from RPGs to music. Physical copies of Entromancy will cease production in 2026.

item.title: How to secure Conquest’s limited edition Krampus for free this Christmas
item.description: Para Bellum Wargames announces the Krampus, a limited edition holiday miniature for Conquest available free with qualifying orders until December 15th.

item.title: Fatshark marks 10 years of ‘Tide’ games with free Darktide Steam weekend
item.description: Fatshark celebrates its third anniversary with a free Steam weekend for Warhammer 40,000: Darktide and a new in-game event offering 500 Aquilas.

item.title: Review: Beyond the Woods Quick Start
item.description: Discover Tír Nascath in this dark fantasy RPG. Our review explores the hexcrawl rules and free adventure found in the Beyond the Woods Quick Start.
